office_does: A Yakima County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases, traffic infractions, civil cases up to $100,000, small claims and protection orders; the four judges are elected countywide.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Judge Gary Hintze is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Yakima County District Court judge since 2022 and a county deputy prosecutor for 22 years before that; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: District Court judge since March 2022; won the 2022 election with about 66% [S1][S2]
Yakima County deputy prosecutor 2000-2022, including supervising the Special Assault Unit [S1]
Judge pro tem in four municipal courts 2011-2022; DMCJA Rules Committee member [S1]
